en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three scenes: a long building along a street, a horse‑drawn carriage with men beside a rocky road, and a panoramic view of a valley town dominated by a conical hill. Caption on the front reads a greeting from Tolmin; handwritten date appears as 1912. The reverse is a standard multilingual 'Postkarte — Carte postale' back with a circular postmark of Tolmin and a receiving/library stamp from Ljubljana, addressed to Trieste.
